# The programme, for a reviewer

A generated front door. Every figure below is derived from the repository's own metadata;
none is transcribed. Where coverage is partial, this page says so rather than rounding up.

## The object

The figure-eight knot complement **m004** -- the unique arithmetic knot complement, trace
field `Q(sqrt-3)`. The programme asks what such an object forces, and reports that it forces
**form** while refusing **values**. Most results are therefore negatives, and that is the
result, not the debt.

**PROVED — `B901`** (430 words, 1 locks)

STRUCTURAL CONCLUSION (the sharpest Lane-C no-go yet): the c -> theta carrier, if it exists, is NOT a real C-stabilizing symmetry -- the transfer must pass through the complexification, exactly where the second measurement's wall lives (B892/B893: det14 > 0 at all three roots). The real/complex alternation (M3) and the Lane-C crux point at the same door: layer 8.

**NEGATIVE — `B899`** (315 words, 1 locks)  
M8, THE HIERARCHY-SOURCE CHECK (fenced, geometry only): the operational S3-breaking magnitudes (B890/B891 per-frame deviations) do NOT correlate with mu's root geometry under the four registered comparisons (nearest-spacing and |mu'| at each root, through the banked frame->root bijection, log-log): one order-match in four tests = exactly the chance rate (each 3-point comparison matches with p = 1/6; four tests give ~52% for >= 1), and every residual is large (2.7-5.4 where a clean power law would sit near 0). ## How to falsify any of this

1. Every closure names an **escape hatch** -- the computation that would reopen it. Pick a
   door in `CLOSED_DOORS.md`, run its hatch; the door holds or it does not.
2. Every PROVED arc names its **test locks**. Run them.
3. The gates (`python3 scripts/gates/gates.py`) enforce the governance invariants, and each
   was verified by deliberate breakage -- a gate never observed to fail is not a gate.

You do not need to read the record to check the programme. That is the point of this page.
